headline: Expiry‑day trades are costing you a lot.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: These expiry‑day trades made up 90 trades and resulted in a loss of ₹1,16,891. On average each of those trades lost ₹1,299, had a win rate of 29% and produced a 28% loss, while the remaining 124 trades averaged a 5% loss, lost ₹449 on average and had a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying the rule to limit expiry‑day trades in the next review period.
